What to understand at MT8

Era Shield
An enormous scaling multiplier affecting enemy durability and damage. Ordinary module upgrades alone can struggle to keep up.
Era power
An extra ability associated with an enemy element. Learn which power is causing trouble before spending to counter it.
Divisor
An upgrade that divides down part of the enemy’s Era scaling. Damage and health-related divisors solve different parts of the problem.

What you are working toward

  • Reach the documented Era 5 milestone and confirm current module objectives in Headquarters.
  • Learn the difference between permanent Era research and upgrades bought inside one tower test.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an suggested route based on community strategies. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Start with a manageable region

    Use an easier region/difficulty such as Forest Easy while learning the system. The purpose is a stable environment where you can see which element and ability stop the run, rather than changing several sources of difficulty at once. [S08]

  2. Open the Era Workshop

    Use the Workshop’s stairs to inspect the Era systems. Analysis reveals information through combat interactions; research works toward persistent improvements; experiments develop further rewards and reductions. Read unlock conditions as each tab becomes available rather than assuming all three are immediately usable. [S08]

  3. Gather analysis deliberately

    Run a blueprint that survives long enough to register the needed hits or kills. Read the specific analysis objective: an attack-focused build may not help a task that needs received hits. The community references notes that v1.0 removed the old minimum-damage rule for registering Era hits. [S08] [S01]

  4. Improve divisors and counter troublesome powers

    Buy the relevant available research with the resources the screen requests. Reduce the costs of disabling powers that are blocking your run, then use those disables in testing. The supplied walkthrough suggests beginning with problematic Forest elements such as Earth and Neutral rather than trying to solve every element immediately. [S08]

  5. Advance a little, then reassess

    Reach a stable Era 1 before pushing farther. If progression fails, identify whether enemies became too durable, too dangerous, or acquired an ability your build cannot handle. Improve the appropriate divisor or counter and retry. [S08]

If you are stuck

My strong old blueprint suddenly deals almost no useful damage

Inspect the Era multipliers and powers. This is the point where researching counters can matter more than another ordinary damage upgrade.

Analysis is not progressing

Check its exact required element and interaction. Avoid assuming all damage or all kills count toward every analysis.

Ready to move on?

  • You can explain which divisors and disables keep your run working.
  • Era 5 and the other current Headquarters objectives are complete.
After the promotion

At MT9, build the XP economy and divisor reductions needed for a much longer Era push. Faster Era software helps only after the tower can handle the enemies it reaches. [S02]
